method: independent Monte Carlo, 169 SeedSequence child streams
hero: fixed real-card representative per suit-isomorphic class
opponent_range: uniform legal 2-card combo from remaining 50 cards
sampling: draw 7 distinct cards uniformly from remaining 50; first 2 opponent, last 5 board
confidence_interval: per-hand normal approximation 95%, not simultaneous across 169 hands
rank_moments: reused exact uniform C(50,5) moments; random opponent leaves board marginal unchanged
limits: all players reach showdown; no fold, betting, rake; close estimated rankings can reverse within sampling error
